proof_scope: live probe execution over the real workstation

claims.proves: the full probe suite executes live against the real workstation, including the W10 inotify-watch budget probe added after the 2026-08-27 exhaustion incident, and reports per-probe pass/warn/fail states
claims.does_not_prove: autofix behavior or nightly scheduler registration

cases.name: live-probe-suite-includes-inotify
cases.note: Runs the real check entrypoint over the live workstation (no fixture stubs). Guards the W10 inotify-watch probe: exhaustion by stale agent sessions (2026-08-27: five codex TUIs held ~640k watches) must be measured on every run, and the codex zombie pattern must be active.

cases.name: inotify-probe-adversarial-limit-readback
cases.note: Adversarial: the probe must measure the kernel budget itself, not quote a cached number - the reported limit must equal /proc/sys/fs/inotify/max_user_watches read independently in the same trial.
command: cd "$(dirname "$0")"/.. && limit=$(cat /proc/sys/fs/inotify/max_user_watches) && uv run python -c "from probes import probe_inotify_watches; r=probe_inotify_watches(); import sys; print(r.probe_id, r.status.value, r.details.get('limit')); sys.exit(0 if r.details.get('limit')==int('$limit') and r.details.get('total',0)>0 else 1)"
